articles.headline: Julian Nagelsmann out as Germany boss, Jürgen Klopp lined up as replacement
articles.description: Julian Nagelsmann is out as the Germany head coach following the team's shock exit from the World Cup at the hands of Paraguay in the round of 32 with talks already being sought with Jürgen Klopp to replace him.

articles.headline: Brazil's Endrick 'at peace' with limited World Cup minutes, has faith in Carlo Ancelotti
articles.description: Brazilian teenager Endrick says he is "at peace" with the limited playing time he is getting at this World Cup, knowing coach Carlo Ancelotti is doing what's best for the team.
